docs.summary: Reads and writes a texture's [`SpriteImportSettings`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Importers.SpriteImportSettings) inside its `.meta` import settings (under the `"sprite"` key). Bridges the Sprite Editor and the [`TextureImporter`](#api~Prowl.Editor.Importers.TextureImporter).

members.name: ReadFrom
members.signature: public static SpriteImportSettings ReadFrom(EchoObject? settings, out bool failed)

docs.summary: Deserializes the sprite settings from a texture's `.meta` settings compound. An absent block legitimately means defaults; a block that is present but unreadable is reported through `failed` so callers can refuse to write over it. Silently substituting defaults would present the texture as having no sprites and let the next save destroy the real slicing.
Settings-only overload, for callers that just build from whatever is readable.

members.signature: public static void WriteInto(EchoObject settings, SpriteImportSettings s)

docs.summary: Serializes the sprite settings into a texture's `.meta` settings compound. A sprite mode makes it a Sprite texture, and no mode turns a Sprite texture back into a Default one.

members.signature: public static SpriteImportSettings Load(Guid textureGuid, out bool failed)

docs.summary: Loads the sprite settings for a texture by GUID. `failed` is true when existing settings could not be read, in which case the caller must not save over them.
